relevanceRationale.presentDay: Signed webhooks with replay protection are current integration practice.
relevanceRationale.practicalUtility: The repaired function is the shape a production receiver needs.
relevanceRationale.transferable: Signature, freshness, grant, tenant and audit order carries to any inbound integration.
relevanceRationale.audienceFit: Fifty minutes, typed TypeScript, fixtures only, no crypto module needed.
relevanceRationale.riskOutcome: Four security criteria are critical, so no security failure averages away.

rationale: Read the prompt, contract, starter, skeleton, hints, approach, criteria, ten visible and thirty hidden assertions and the harness. Graded 16 variants through gradePathCode. Two defects found and fixed in lib/learning-paths/solutions/fde-m03.ts: (1) a secure receiver that checks lengths before ctx.safeEqual, as the lesson's Node sketch does, failed the critical signature criterion because the acceptPair oracle was shorter than the genuine signature; the oracle now has the genuine length, so === still fails and the length-check form passes. (2) a receiver that skipped the audit entry on grant_revoked, grant_expired, bad_payload and unknown_ticket refusals passed every criterion despite the prompt requiring one entry per delivery; a hidden core assertion now checks those four entries, and scripts/test-learning-paths.ts gained the known-wrong variant "grant refusals not audited" (core). Wording is 4: the prompt says a revokedAt that is "set" but unparseable counts as revoked, and a hidden test treats an empty string as set, which a learner using a truthiness check will miss.
evidence: run: PATHS_ONLY=fde npm run test:paths on 2026-10-22 passes (reference visible+hidden, starter examples, ten known-wrong variants for this receiver).

run: scratch gradePathCode probe 2026-10-22 after the fix: reference 30/30 hidden and all five criteria; length-precheck variant passes; 14 flawed variants fail their criterion (no audit on refusals -> core; claim before lookup, past-only or >= tolerance, loose timestamp -> replay; grant after read, future revocation counted, expired before revoked, truthy revokedAt -> permission-freshness; tenant after lookup -> tenant-isolation; re-serialized body, unsplit header -> signature; mutation -> core); starter fails all five.
